rule: Changing how often a pulse repeats changes nothing when a round goes out between its read and its write
past: preventive: without the check, the new rule lands on a series whose next round was just scheduled on the old one
check: cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run src/server/services/change-repeat.test.ts -t 'between its read and its write'
fails: between its read and its write
